description: This file defines a mock class 'MainThreadMock' for testing purposes, which implements the 'IMainThread' interface. It uses Google Mock to create mock methods for client registration, unregistration, and task enqueueing.

classes.name: MainThreadMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IMainThread interface for testing purposes.

methods.name: registerClient
methods.description: Mocks the registration of a client, returning an int32_t status code.

methods.name: unregisterClient
methods.description: Mocks the unregistration of a client given its clientId.

methods.name: enqueueTask
methods.description: Mocks enqueueing a task for a specific client.

methods.name: enqueueTaskAndWait
methods.description: Mocks enqueueing a task and waiting for its completion for a specific client.
